name: LCHIP Land Conservation Grants

funder.name: New Hampshire Land and Community Heritage Investment Program (LCHIP)

summary: Grants to New Hampshire municipalities and publicly supported nonprofits to permanently conserve ecologically valuable land, such as wildlife habitat, wetlands and riparian areas, by buying it or acquiring a conservation easement. One round a year.

amount.note: LCHIP pays at most 50% of total project cost

reporting: Recipients submit an annual monitoring report to LCHIP, starting the calendar year after acquisition.

calls.label: Annual grant round
calls.recurring: One round a year; full proposals due in mid-June.

status.quote: LCHIP offers one grant round per calendar year

applicant_types.quote: Municipality or other political subdivision of the state of New Hampshire, or a Publicly supported nonprofit corporation exempt from federal income tax

geography.quote: assisted community groups across New Hampshire

access.quote: Prospective applicants must complete and submit a "Letter of Intent" (LOI) form.

window.quote: LCHIP offers one grant round per calendar year

reporting.quote: a monitoring report must be submitted to LCHIP

amount.quote: the LCHIP grant may not exceed 50% of the project's Total Project Cost. In addition: 1) Awards for Acquisition or Rehabilitation projects must be between $10,000 and $500,000.

co_finance_required.quote: awards matching grants to NH communities and non-profits
